page_texts.1: Read `.claude/commands/eap-chat-resume.md` for the full workflow. Load `.tmp/session-context.md` — if missing, tell the user to run `/chat-save` first. Check for staleness (>24h) and detect drift by comparing saved state against current `git status`, `git log`, and branch. Present a resume briefing with TODO items front and center, project context, key decisions, accomplishments, and active files. Read the active files for context. Do not start working automatically — ask the user which TODO to pick up first.
